LIVEFORGE · Quick Setup

Get your LIVE running ✨

Install LIVEFORGE, pair your Roblox account once, then connect your TikTok username whenever you go live.

First-time setup

Follow these steps to connect your own installation.

Pair once · reconnect whenever you stream
Step 01

Install LIVEFORGE

Download and run LIVEFORGE Setup.exe. Open the app and wait for the bridge and tunnel to show as connected. You do not need to install Node.js or other developer tools.

Open LIVEFORGE✓
Step 02 · One time

Pair your Roblox account

Copy the one-time pairing code shown in LIVEFORGE. Join the Roblox game, choose Pair LIVEFORGE, enter the code and confirm. Once paired, this installation should stay linked.

Pair once per installation✓
Step 03 · Roblox

Open the new Roblox game

Join the official interactive 2 experience. After pairing, the game should move past the waiting screen and let you choose a map and start your session.

Open the Roblox game↗
Step 04 · Every stream

Connect TikTok LIVE

In LIVEFORGE, enter your TikTok username and click Connect TikTok LIVE. Keep LIVEFORGE open while streaming. Viewers can then submit Roblox usernames in your TikTok LIVE chat.

Connect and start streaming✓
After the first pairing, everyday setup is simple: open LIVEFORGE, enter your TikTok username, press Connect, and launch the Roblox game. Keep LIVEFORGE running while you stream.
